subject: Edge zone ownership & private link validation for Helios pilot
messages:
From: Ellen Park <security@helios-analytics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Torres <m.torres@helios-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 08:14:32 -0700
Subject: Edge zone ownership & private link validation for Helios pilot

Jonas —

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our pilot approval we need explicit confirmation of the following items for Helios tenant #HLX-1194 (EU-only):

- Which physical/region zones in the EU will host our production inference workloads (list of AZs or provider zones and the region that owns them).
- Proof that the PrivateLink / VPC endpoint you propose is a customer-dedicated endpoint (ownership, tunnel/peering topology) and that traffic egress remains in EU control.
- KMS key residency for tenant-encrypted data and whether we provide a customer-managed key option.
- Any applicable SOC 2 / CAIQ sections that demonstrate controls for regional isolation and private connectivity.

We attached our standard hosting checklist (Helios-Hosting-Checklist-v2.pdf) — can you fill in or provide artifacts? We need an initial response within 72 hours to keep the pilot on schedule.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Head of Security, Helios Analytics
security@helios-analytics.com

Attachment: Helios-Hosting-Checklist-v2.pdf

Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:02:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Edge zone ownership & private link validation for Helios pilot

Ellen —

Appreciate the clear checklist. Quick confirmation up front: we can host Helios tenant data exclusively in EU regions (we operate dedicated pools in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1) and we can provision a customer-specific PrivateLink/VPC endpoint.

Next steps from our side:
- I’ll pull together a short evidence packet (hosting map, VPC diagram, and KMS residency statement).
- Rishi, can you prepare the KMS residency note and confirm whether we can support a customer-managed key (CMK) for this pilot?
- Marissa/Kimberly — can we export the relevant CAIQ/SOC 2 sections that map to cross-region controls and private connectivity? A one-page mapping to Helios checklist questions would be ideal.

We’ll aim to get you the packet within 48 hours. If Helios needs a signed statement for PrivateLink ownership, we can produce a short ownership statement (PDF) for legal.

On timelines — we’ll prioritize this.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:18:44 -0700
Subject: Internal: Helios evidence plan (HLX-2027-PILOT-1194)

Team —

Summary of what Ellen asked for and what I plan to include in the packet (we will attach these to the reply to Helios):

1) Hosting topology map (redwood-eu-hosting-map.png) — show region ownership (eu-west-1 primary), placement of dedicated pools, and network egress boundaries. Mark the tenant isolation layer and any shared infrastructure components.

2) PrivateLink / VPC endpoint statement (private-link-ownership-statement.md) — short prose + a diagram that indicates customer-dedicated endpoint, whether it is a managed gateway or direct peering, and where termination occurs. Include the NAT/egress behavior and how we ensure EU egress.

3) KMS residency and CMK option (kms-region-clarity.pdf) — confirm AWS KMS key locality, key material residency, and steps to enable customer-managed key for the pilot. Rishi — can you confirm if CMK lifecycle actions require customer console access or we can perform via supported APIs? Also note SE policy for key rotation and export restrictions.

4) SOC 2 / CAIQ excerpt (soc2-relevant-sections.pdf) — Marissa, please extract the controls that map to network segmentation, encryption at rest/in transit, and change control for private links. A one-chart matrix mapping our control IDs to Helios checklist rows would be great.

I drafted quick attachments and put them in the Drive folder (link below) — see the draft hosting map and the private-link statement. Please review and add technical details or redlines by EOD tomorrow. I’ll run the packet by Legal if Helios requests a signed attestation.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBz-Redwood-Helios-Evidence

Thanks —
Jonas

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <security@helios-analytics.com>
Cc: Michael Torres <m.torres@helios-analytics.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 16:47:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Edge zone ownership & private link validation for Helios pilot

Ellen —

Thanks again for the checklist. Attached is the evidence packet for HLX-2027-PILOT-1194: a hosting topology map, our PrivateLink ownership statement, the KMS residency note, and the SOC 2/CAIQ excerpts mapped to your requested rows. Key points summarized below for quick review: 

- Hosting zones: Helios pilot will be pinned to eu-west-1 (primary) with standby capacity in eu-central-1. The attached map (redwood-eu-hosting-map.png) highlights dedicated pool IDs and the tenant isolation layer.
- PrivateLink / VPC endpoint: We provision a customer-dedicated endpoint that terminates in the EU tenant VPC. Traffic egress remains in-region; we do not route Helios production inference tokens through non-EU egress points. See private-link-ownership-statement.md for topology and ownership language.
- KMS: We can support a customer-managed key (CMK) for this pilot. kms-region-clarity.pdf explains the steps to provision the CMK in Helios' AWS account (recommended) or via a Redwood-managed CMK confined to eu-west-1. Key rotation and lifecycle are documented.
- Compliance excerpts: soc2-relevant-sections.pdf maps relevant SOC 2 criteria and CAIQ questions to our controls for segmentation, encryption, and private connectivity.

Attachments: redwood-eu-hosting-map.png, private-link-ownership-statement.md, kms-region-clarity.pdf, soc2-relevant-sections.pdf

Next steps: tell us if you want a signed attestation for PrivateLink ownership (we can have Legal generate a short certificate). If the pilot requires the CMK to be created in your account, provide the AWS account ID and the preferred key alias and we’ll send the provisioning playbook.

Onboarding contact: Rishi Malhotra (rishi_malhotra@redwood.com) will own CMK provisioning; Marissa will coordinate compliance artifacts. We’re available for a 30-minute walkthrough if helpful.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
